name: grey-season
description: Grey Season - browser multiplayer open-world zombie survival FPS

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server
